name: National Citizen's Initiative for Democracy (NI4D)
content:
Note: the following entry is a stub. Please help us complete it.Problems and Purpose 
  The National Citizen's Initiative for Democracy (NI4D) is a proposal to make a constitutional amendment which would have permitted people to make or change laws by initiative at all levels of government, including at the federal level. A national initiative refers to proposals within the United States to allow for ballot initiatives at the federal level. 
  Background History and Context 
  Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities 
  The initiative was started by the now defunct Democracy Foundation and spearheaded by Mike Gravel, a former U.S. Senator, and Ralph Nader, author and former Independent candidate for President of the United States.
